name: Carrion King

alignment.name: Unaligned
alignment.description:
Unaligned creatures don’t actively seek to harm others or wish them ill. But such creatures also don’t go out of their way to put themselves at risk without some hope for reward. They support law and order when doing so benefits them. They value their own freedom, without worrying too much about protecting the freedom of others.
	A few unaligned people, and most unaligned deities, aren’t undecided about alignment. Rather, they’ve chosen not to choose, either because they see the benefits of both good and evil or because they see themselves as above the concerns of morality. The Raven Queen and her devotees fall into the latter camp, believing that moral choices are irrelevant to their mission, since death comes to all creatures regardless of alignment.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Fungal Bed
traits.details: When the Carrion King rolls initiative, an area of living fungus appears in a close burst 5 and remains until the end of the encounter. The area is difficult terrain for enemies. If a creature makes an area or close attack that includes this area, the creature can target the Carrion King.

traits.name: Unstoppable
traits.details: If the Carrion King starts his turn unable to take actions, drop the body recharges, and the Carrion King can use it as no action. If the Carrion King does so, unless he spends an action point, he can take only a minor action and a standard action that turn.

hit.description: necrotic and poison damage, and the Carrion King slides the target up to 4 squares.
necrotic and poison damage, and the target falls prone.

effect.description: The Carrion King makes two basic attacks.

hit.description: necrotic and poison damage, and the target is weakened (save ends).

effect.description: Close burst 1; the burst creates a zone of fungal growth that lasts until the end of the Carrion King’s next turn. Any creature that enters or starts its turn in the zone is dazed while the zone persists. After the Carrion King creates the zone, he is removed from play, harmful effects on him end, and he reappears in a space in the fungal bed area.

hit.description: The target moves up to its speed toward its nearest ally, then makes an at-will attack against the ally.

powers.name: Spreading Rebirth
powers.trigger: The Carrion King is first bloodied.

effect.description: Drop the body recharges, and the Carrion King uses it. Instead of reappearing in his Huge form, he reappears in three Large bodies. Each body has 100 hit points, lacks the Carrion King’s traits and encounter powers, and is considered to be bloodied.
